M12 — 2026-10-05
@beads/bd's npm postinstall runs `bd version` under the INSTALLING HOME, even when npm prints its install-scripts warning, and creates ~/.beads and ~/.config/bd there. Install a beads pin as `HOME=<scratch> npm install --prefix ~/.bench/beads-<v> @beads/bd@<v>`. That is what created them in the real HOME on 2026-10-05 08:40 (the 1.3.1 pin).
